entities.name: Philagrius of Epirus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philagrius of Epirus was a Greek medical writer from Epirus, who lived after Galen and before Oribasius, and therefore probably in the 3rd century CE. According to the Suda he was a pupil of a physician named Naumachius, and practised his profession chiefly at Thessalonica.
